comparison.objective: Remove three remove-before-flight items from an aircraft and stow all of them in a kit bag.
comparison.physical_skill: Identify, extract, and contain several fitted safety items.
comparison.success_condition: Each entire item must be removed and bagged; loose removed items receive no credit. Detailed fit, force, damage, and stability thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both require removal and containment, this record extracts reusable whole covers/pins. It does not test mandrel alignment, notch fracture, hammer coordination, or preservation of a surrounding insert.
